proposal.hypothesis: Using a single full warp for all 2 <= n <= 128 may avoid the shared-memory barriers of the existing 128-thread CTA: each lane performs up to four bounded loads, then the existing warp sum writes directly to out. This contrasts with the prior warp-only-through-32 variant. Keep n=1 on the baseline no-kernel device-to-device copy path; the supplied aggregate timings do not isolate n=1 or establish a per-size crossover.

retained: For 2 <= n <= 128, use a single 32-thread CTA: each lane conditionally accumulates input[lane + j*32] for j=0..3, performs the existing full-warp integer sum, and writes directly to out.
Preserve the n=1 asynchronous device-to-device copy path and retain the existing hierarchical reduction for larger sizes.
